notes: YouTube Data API. Outward: video uploads and video updates (privacy can turn public), comments, replies, moderation (SET_COMMENT_MODERATION_STATUS can ban an author), spam marks, ratings, abuse reports, subscriptions, thumbnails and the channel banner. Writes: playlists, channel sections, captions, channel settings. Destructive: deletes. YOUTUBE_SUBSCRIBE_CHANNEL stays money by name (Connect never lowers a money name). LOAD_CAPTIONS and GET_VIDEO_DETAILS_BATCH are reads.
